bukti: The goal of this research is to present a method for classifying the ripeness levels of oil palm fruits using deep learning techniques applied to image data.
Training and validation datasets represent precision of 99.4%, recall of 99.6%, mean average precision at 50% (mAP50) of 99.5%, and mAP50-95 of 92.6%.
catatan: Tugas diberi kode DET karena model YOLOv9n dievaluasi dengan mAP; abstrak sendiri menyebutnya klasifikasi kematangan, sehingga KLS juga dapat dibela. Lokasi pengambilan citra tidak dinyatakan.

bukti: The purpose of this paper is to determine total emissivity as an essential parameter of non-destructive thermometry for oil palm fresh fruit bunches in different stage of ripeness
the fresh fruit bunches were heated to 100°C. Then, a thermal imaging camera and contact thermometer were used to determine the surface temperature of the bunches.
catatan: Kajian laboratorium tentang emisivitas termal tandan per tingkat kematangan; tidak ada klasifikasi per tandan sehingga per_kelas N. Dimasukkan sebagai C3 karena protokol mencakup pengindraan non-RGB pada tandan sawit; bila pengecualian E2 diterapkan ketat pada kerja laboratorium, kajian ini berada di batas.

bukti: This paper introduces a relative entropy based image processing approach for the non-destructive prediction of the maturity of oil palm fresh fruit bunches (FFB)
The results of an experimental study of applying the Kullback–Leibler distance to the problem of oil palm classification are presented.

bukti: palm-oil mills in Thailand employ staff to visually assess the ripeness of fresh palm bunches at point of purchase.
develop a deep-learning model that can be used to analyze photographs of oil palm fresh fruit bunches and accurately classify their ripeness.
the ResNet50(C) model provided the best adjusted accuracy at 90%, where the F1 score of each category was noted to be higher than 80% ripeness.
